body.text: Plaintiff [NAME], pro se, moves the Court for an Order compelling Defendant [NAME] (“[SHORT]”) to serve complete responses to [Interrogatories Nos. __ and Requests for Production Nos. __], and for Plaintiff's reasonable expenses incurred in making this motion, pursuant to Wis. Stat. §§ 804.09 and 804.12(1), with sanctions available for noncompliance under Wis. Stat. § 804.12(2).

Plaintiff conferred with [opposing counsel] in good faith in an effort to obtain the discovery without court action. [Describe: date, method, what was asked, what was answered.] The dispute could not be resolved. Wisconsin imposes no general meet-and-confer prerequisite, but the record of conferral bears directly on whether Defendant's position was substantially justified under Wis. Stat. § 804.12(1)(c).
I. [Request No. __]: Defendant's response is an evasive or incomplete answer and is therefore a failure to answer under Wis. Stat. § 804.12(1)(b).
REQUEST NO. __: [the request as served, verbatim]

[Explain the actual defect: an evasive or incomplete answer under § 804.12(1)(b), an unjustified specific objection under §§ 804.08(1)(b) or 804.09(2)(b)1, or a total failure to serve answers or objections under § 804.12(4). A timely specific objection may take the place of the objected-to answer; it does not automatically require a protective-order motion. Explain relevance and proportionality under § 804.01(2)(a), then address each objection on its merits.]
II. [Next request. Same structure. One heading per request, not one heading for all of them.]

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court enter an order (1) compelling Defendant to serve complete responses to [requests] on or before [DATE]; (2) requiring a privilege log identifying any material withheld on a claim of privilege, with sufficient detail to permit the claim to be tested; (3) requiring a sworn certification describing the search conducted as to any request Defendant answers with “no documents”; (4) awarding Plaintiff his reasonable expenses incurred in making this motion under Wis. Stat. § 804.12(1)(c); and (5) granting such other and further relief as the Court deems just and proper.
